say:1:1711166001:1.text: I think I had a very long dream.
say:1:1711166001:1.source_cn: 我好像……做了一个很漫长的梦。

say:2:1711166002:1.text: In my dream, I kept falling into an endless black fog.
say:2:1711166002:1.source_cn: 梦中，我一直在一片无边无际的黑雾里不断坠落。

say:4:1711166004:1.text: Am I still dreaming at this moment?
say:4:1711166004:1.source_cn: 此时此刻，我仍在梦中吗？

say:6:1711166005:1.text: No… Maxim, this isn’t a dream. Hold my hand tightly, feel it.
say:6:1711166005:1.source_cn: 不……马克西姆，这不是梦。握紧我的手，感受它。

say:7:1711166006:1.text: Why are your hands so cold?

say:9:1711166008:1.text: But this warmth, this touch, are all real. I pulled you back from the darkness.
say:9:1711166008:1.source_cn: 但这份温度，这份触感，皆为真实。我把你从黑雾里拉回来了。

say:10:1711166009:1.text: This isn't the place to talk, Maxim. Let's go back to your quarters first.
say:10:1711166009:1.source_cn: 这里也不是说话的地方，马克西姆，我们先回你的寝殿吧。

say:11:1711166010:1.text: You have just woken up and your body still needs rest.
say:11:1711166010:1.source_cn: 你刚刚苏醒，身体依然需要休息。
